fact: A Chadian planning ministry adviser lists, among reforms strengthening the national statistical system, the adoption of the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (SNDS 2021-2025) by Decree N°0573/PCMT/PMT/MEPDCI/2021 of 14 October 2021.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2022-2026.
